faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Juvenile Justice Board Erode recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Juvenile Justice Board Erode recruitment is 08 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the board before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Junior Assistant cum Typist and Office Assistant in the Juvenile Justice Board Erode.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant post is 8th Standard or equivalent pass.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in this recruitment is 42 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Assistant cum Typist post?
faq.answer: The Junior Assistant cum Typist post offers a salary of Rs. 20000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Juvenile Justice Board Erode recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on merit, considering the candidate's qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Juvenile Justice Board Erode, which is erode.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are on a contractual basis.
